verdicts.reason: A breaks the headline awkwardly ('House Blend, slow / roasted.'), leaving 'roasted.' as a near-orphan, and the 'Whole bean or ground to order' line shrinks to tiny, illegible text crammed beside a postage-stamp logo, with the body copy jammed against that bottom row. B keeps the headline on one strong line with cleaner vertical rhythm, but enlarges the fine print to nearly body size, which inverts the hierarchy. Both also share these flaws: the brand logo is shrunk to an afterthought next to the badge, and the halo disc behind the CTA is detached and clipped at the right edge.
